Reserve · $50 deposit

The deposit goes toward your price. Made after you reserve. Ships Jan 2027 (placeholder).

The story

In Lisu tradition, silver carries the wishes women see in the world around them: fish, butterflies, the forest. The cuff takes its line from the ridges that fold away from a highland village at dawn.

Materials & making

925 sterling silver. Forged and finished by hand in Chiang Mai. Stone version uses lab-grown stones, always labeled as such.

Numbering & certificate

Each cuff is stamped with its edition number and ships with a certificate naming the piece, the edition and the maker.

Shipping & returns

Placeholder terms. Final ship dates, refund rules and made-to-order conditions are set before launch.

The Lisu woman

Silver is her worth, kept close.

Three stories we are keeping, one for each drop.

Her souls

A woman has seven souls.

In Lisu tradition, as Asami tells it, a woman carries seven souls. When one wanders, it is called home. Silver is worn to keep her whole.

Women have seven souls in the Thai Lisu tradition. Men have nine.

Her mountains · Drop 01

Wishes made in nature.

Fish, butterflies, the forest. Motifs vary from family to family. In the Lisu villages, trees are honored with ribbons.

See the Highland Cuff
Her passages

Silver at every threshold.

A silver piece in a baby’s first week, given with her name. A ring at marriage. A full set of silver at New Year.

About

Made by Lisu women.

Asami grew up Lisu in northern Thailand and ran a silver and gold shop in Chiang Mai. Her daughter Benjy studies jewelry design at GIA and draws the pieces.

Together they decide what is made, and what is not. Items tied to ancestors, parents and teachers are never copied or sold.

Asami

The keeper

Shares the stories and the traditions behind each drop.

Benjy

The designer

Draws each piece and decides how it is made.

The soul of Lisu

Silver is how a Lisu woman wears her dignity, her worth, and her pride in being a woman.
